policy.normalExecution: capability-and-smoke evidence wins; newer compatible versions are allowed
policy.incompatibleUpdate: report and keep current known-good runtime until compatibility repair is reviewed
policy.frozenTools: do not monitor for upgrades unless owner explicitly unfreezes

artifactMeta.uncertainty: check_failed/unavailable rows and best-effort release lookup remain explicit; no auto-upgrade inference
artifactMeta.refreshTarget: next Velvet Research Seat 02:00 upstream check or explicit upstream review task
